member.para: The final chapter one book lost to this hole. "Paula Monti", 2026-07-31: chapter 25 was heard as "1ère partie, chapitre ban 5, douleur" at 4:23:03 and never looked at again, being past the last detected chapter and so in no gap at all. Re-running that file with this in place, the upgrade model read the same window as chapter 25 on the first attempt, before either re-framing was needed.

The re-hearing the bounds rule refuses. Observed as "CHAPTER X" over an already-found chapter 10 on "I Shall Wear Midnight", 2026-07-31 - a number that cannot continue the sequence, so it cannot produce a mark.
